name: Assetz Miru & Miyo
description: A 3 BHK-only community of 350 homes on about 6 acres in Yelahanka, with about 77% of the site kept open. The plan centres on a sunken courtyard with an amphitheatre, and the architecture uses terracotta accents.
curation: Only 350 homes on about 6 acres, all 3 BHK
A sunken central courtyard with an amphitheatre
About a minute from Orchids The International School
connectivity: Orchids The International School, about 1 min
Upcoming Blue Line Metro, about 12 mins
developerNote: Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Bengaluru, Assetz Property Group lists 50+ projects and over 50 million sq.ft of development in its portfolio.
photoDescription: Dark-toned tower above a landscaped courtyard at dusk
